page.layout: One page of index. Running title "INDEX" with roman page number "X" at the head. Below it, a single column of entries, each a question with its page number at the right. Catchword "Raia" and gathering signature "St 4" at the foot.

main_text.l: Quastio an subiectum morbi & sanitatis sit
Quastio an humores sint subiectum morbi & sanitatis , 8
Quastio largius sit cœnandum quam pranden- dum 74
Quastio vtrum sit magis obnoxium, potando an vorando excedere modum 82
Quastio an a potu omnino sit abstinendum inter medio prandii & cœna tempore 89
Quastio an hyeme plus edere conueniat quam æstate, propterea quod ventres sint tempore hiberno calidiores, æstate vero frigidiores 97
Quastio an alimentum sit tantum dicendum quod nutrit 103
Quastio morbi communes etiam oriantur à ma- lorum ciborum copia & culpa 109
Quastio an ciborum natura & potestas ad varia gentium ingenia moresq; aliquid conferat, 111
Quæstio, morbi quod quibusdam gentibus pe- culiariter accidant, an vitius ratio in causa sit, & cur repente quidam hominibus ori- antur in certis membris consuetudinem de- nique plurimum valere 122

page.notes: The first word of the entries is printed with a long s and no visible ae ligature, so it is given as "Quastio". The entry "vitius" is copied as printed. The page number "97" is read from "9s". The signature "St 4" is uncertain. The top title is read as the running head "INDEX", with the roman "X" taken as the page number.
